trap.label: existing
trap.wrong: Incidence counts new cases; prevalence counts the cases existents.
trap.right: Incidence counts new cases; prevalence counts the existing cases.
trap.why: Em português o adjetivo vem depois do substantivo (“casos existentes”). Em inglês, adjetivos vêm antes, e existent não é o termo usual: existing.

mcq.q: A doubled relative risk could be...

fix.wrong: The risk is two times bigger.
fix.right: The risk is twice as high.

fix.wrong: The disease incidence increased in 10 per 1,000.
fix.right: The disease incidence increased by 10 per 1,000.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com twice as: “The risk is two times higher.”
rewrite.answer: The risk is twice as high.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com existing: “the cases that exist now”
Reescreva com by: “The rate rose 10 per 1,000.”
